titleCard.title: Sift
titleCard.subtitle: Twelve bids for the same job. The low one is $52,500 under the winner. Is it a better deal, or is it pricing less work?

closeCard.title: The agent recommends. The human decides.
closeCard.subtitle: Real Strands Swarm, AgentSkills, Context Injection and GoalLoop - with a deterministic core the model never touches.

beats.title: One case, a person and an agent
lines: Sift is decision infrastructure: one live case that a person and a Strands agent work on together.
A decision pack declares what has to be established before an answer is allowed - the obligations, the criteria, and the interventions that police them.
Three decision packs share one engine here: subcontractor bids, a car purchase, and a household energy bill. This is the bids one.

beats.title: Two Strands topologies
lines: Where the handoffs should be the model's call, that engine runs a Strands Swarm - bids, home energy.

beats.title: Two Strands topologies
lines: Where the order is fixed, it runs a Strands Graph instead. Same pack format either way.

beats.title: The core the model never touches
lines: Scoring and ranking are a deterministic core: one dependency, its own contracts. No model, no network, no filesystem.
The arithmetic you are about to check was never produced by a model. Everything above that line is Strands.

beats.title: Twelve bids for the same job
lines: Twelve plumbing bids for a school renovation. Cedar and Sons is cheapest, and prices sixty-two and a half percent of the required scope.
Better deal, or pricing less work?

beats.title: A Swarm, steered mid-run
lines: One request starts the Swarm: six nodes, six stages, five handoffs - and the handoffs are the model's decision.
Each specialist loads only the AgentSkill its obligation needs: scope normalization, price arithmetic, credential verification, schedule analysis. Four activations in this run.
A Context Injector refreshes the weights, the open scope gaps and the remaining budget every turn. Twenty-eight injections.

beats.title: A Swarm, steered mid-run
lines: And watch the scope analyst: completed, redirected once.
It was circling the same two bids, so a Guide intervention steered it onto the third.

beats.title: Refused before it ran
lines: Here is a Deny. The price analyst reached for the licence lookup, a tool this pack grants only to the credential checker, and was refused before it ran.
Not a failure. An authority boundary, recorded as one.

beats.title: The agent refuses to answer
lines: Then the one that matters. GoalLoop ran the recommendation through a callable validator, and the validator threw out attempt one.
The draft ranked twelve bids that were not yet on a common scope basis. That is not a badly written answer, it is a false one.
GoalLoop handed the reason back and the synthesizer went round again. Every bid-levelling tool will happily rank an unfair comparison. This one refuses.

beats.title: Arithmetic you can check
lines: Cedar is silent on three things the others price: permits, eighteen thousand; shower-valve rough-in, thirty-one five; haul-away, six thousand.
Corrected, Cedar is two seventy-nine against Northgate's two seventy-six. The bid that looked fifty-two thousand cheaper is three thousand more expensive.

beats.title: It won't call two questions closed
lines: It names a winner and still will not close two questions: a scope comparison that came back incomplete, and two bids failing credential verification.
Degraded evidence does not count as settled.

beats.title: A constraint that outranks a score
lines: Change the priorities and the ranking moves. That is the deterministic core, not the model.
The sixth criterion has no slider: credentials are set by the pack and cannot be reweighted.

beats.title: A constraint that outranks a score
lines: Now Two Rivers scores highest of all twelve, ninety-one percent against the winner's seventy-two, and still does not win.
Flagged, not removed. Still ranked, and still yours to decide.

beats.title: The person decides, on camera
lines: Awarding is gated by a Confirm intervention: the proposal sits pending, with no approving actor, until a person acts.
So I act. Select Northgate Plumbing.
The case is now Decided. The agent recommended it; a human awarded it, and that boundary is structural.

beats.title: Proof it is really Strands
lines: This is the Runtime Inspector. The SDK's lifecycle hooks, before and after every tool call and model call, on every node and every handoff, are normalized into these events and correlated by one trace id.
Four hundred and thirty-three runtime events in that first run. It is deployed and live, and every mechanism you just watched has a test that fails if it stops being true.
It refused to rank twelve bids until they were comparable, flagged the highest scorer instead of hiding it, and left the award to a person.
